problem: finite h x w block that Rule 30 forbids locally, but that a long period-2 centre would force in columns -1..+1 or -2..+2
kill_reason: Period-2 residual SCCs are nonempty at radii 1 and 2 for both phases 01 and 10 (the known residual: 4 and 8 vertices). Every residual edge obeys x'=L XOR (C OR R) on interior cells, so no 3x3 or 4x4 local-rule violation appears on any residual walk, and none is forced on every sufficiently long path. Only the centre column is fixed; columns ±1 and ±2 remain free. Locally illegal patterns are therefore not forced. The prize-seed spacetime through t=64 contains no illegal 3x3 (8379 windows) or 4x4 (8184 windows). Distinct from residual emptiness: the residual is nonempty, which is exactly why this forbidden-block route dies. Not a prize claim.
encoding: row-major; cell (r,c) is bit (r*w+c); bit 0 is top-left; interior constraints on rows 1..h-1 and columns 1..w-2
